title: Caption-aware GroupClips / UngroupClips
aggregateCanonical: sha256 of sorted "digest  path\n" lines of sourceSha256
bounds: GroupClips / UngroupClips with captions or markers present do not retarget, drop, or burn cues. A later default MoveClips of one member expands the selection group, translates grouped members together, leaves a source gap, follows clipLocal cues and markers, leaves absolute cues at authored times, and reprojects still-covered source cues.

includeLinks=false still moves only the explicit IDs. After UngroupClips, a later move of one member leaves the other cue in place. An ungrouped move that would overlap a neighbor remains whole-group COLLISION. Lifting a clipLocal-marker host remains REF_NOT_FOUND. An uncovering or cropping interval remains ANCHOR_OUT_OF_RANGE. The single-clip Move button stays MoveClip and is not silently expanded.

A real UI path imports AV, extracts persistent audio, splits, adds left and right cues, groups the two remnants, commits a multi-select move, then undoes, redoes, archives a fork, and exports a VTT sidecar. Preview and MP4 still refuse CAPTION_RENDER_POLICY_NOT_IMPLEMENTED.

Already-delivered insert-move leave-gap, SetTrackState locked, field-aware invert including SetMarkers, overwrite, LiftClips/Cut, caption default/follow/interval/source-window, marker absolute default / clipLocal follow / ripple interval, 1000 seeded random undo, and the opened section-3 geometry matrix stay unchanged. Auto-close-on-move, new-track, cross-project bake, OS clipboard, source-interval crop, marker sidecar formats, a complete invert matrix, I-006, MP4 burn-in, video/caption mute/solo, syncLock, and the table's 0.02s off-grid offset are not in this slice.
